items.sentence: Today, one isolated island sat alone in the wide calm sea.
Before someone told a joke, there was an awkward silence.
A listener shows sympathy by naming her friend's sadness.
The terrifying mask is only cardboard, so children stay calm.
The optimistic farmer smiled at the small green seedlings.
One sincere thank you note made the librarian smile brightly.
Before the clouds pass over the valley, rain is likely.
Today, desert cactuses endure many hot days without any rain.
Today, puzzle games build cognitive skills in young curious minds.
Today, still lake water can reflect the tall snowy mountain peaks.
